subject: general
question: Which of the following cities hosted the 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) Convention held in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) Convention** was held in **Indore, Madhya Pradesh**, in **January 2023**.
 
• The theme of the 19th PBD was **"Diaspora: Reliable Partners for India’s Progress in Amrit Kaal."**
 
• Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is celebrated to mark the **contribution of the Overseas Indian community to India’s development.** It is organized by the Ministry of External Affairs.
 
• It is observed annually to commemorate **the return of Mahatma Gandhi from South Africa to India on 9 January 1915**.
 
• The event provides a platform for the Government of India to engage and connect with the overseas Indian community and enable the diaspora to interact with each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD):**

 
 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas** was first celebrated in **2003**, initiated by the Government of India to recognize the contributions of the Indian diaspora globally.
 
• The **date January 9** was chosen as it marks the day Mahatma Gandhi returned to India from South Africa in **1915**, a key moment in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• PBD conventions are held every two years, with smaller events organized annually.
 
• These conventions are attended by overseas Indians, policymakers, and stakeholders, facilitating dialogue and collaboration.
 
 
 
• **Indore:**
 
 
• **Indore** is the largest city in **Madhya Pradesh** and is known for its rich heritage, culture, and food.
 
• The city has won the **Swachh Survekshan (Cleanliness Survey)** award multiple times consecutively, making it one of the cleanest cities in India.
 
• Indore is also an educational hub, housing prestigious institutions like **IIM Indore and IIT Indore**.
 
• It is well-connected by road, rail, and air, making it a suitable venue for large-scale events.
 
 
 
• **Purpose and Importance of PBD:**
 
 
• The event aims to strengthen the emotional and cultural connection between India and its diaspora.
 
• It provides a platform for **NRI and PIO communities** to engage in policy discussions and explore business opportunities in India.
 
• The Government uses the occasion to honor notable contributions by Indians living abroad through the **Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Awards**.
 
 
 
• **Previous Hosts of PBD:**
 
 
• **2019:** The 15th PBD was held in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh**, with the theme "Role of Indian Diaspora in building New India."
 
• **2017:** Bengaluru hosted the 14th PBD with the theme "Redefining engagement with the Indian diaspora."
 
• Other cities that have hosted PBD include **New Delhi, Kochi, and Gandhinagar**.
